# Ruby Gillis

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** Deceased  <sub>[v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030), [v3 c18 P3](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0003)</sub>
- **Role:** Teacher  <sub>[v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>

## Appearance

Ruby possessed showy looks with a brilliant complexion, large bright-blue eyes, and long golden braids. She had a plump, showy figure during her youth. Later, as her health declined, she grew very thin with transparent hands and a hectically brilliant color in her cheeks.

_Sources: [v1 c28 P3](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0003), [v1 c30 P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c14 P5](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0005)_

## Personality

Ruby was cheerful, good-tempered, and enjoyed life frankly, though she was prone to hysterics during alarming situations. She was deeply preoccupied with boys, young men, and romance from a young age, often boasting about her suitors and compliments.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 c23 P16](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0016), [v1 c30 P6](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0006), [v1 c35 P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059), [v3 c4 P71](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0071)_

## Abilities

- Charming away warts using a magic pebble  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>

## Goals

- To have many suitors and a gay time before settling down  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015), [v1 c26 P5](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0005), [v2 c26 P59](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0059)</sub>
- To teach for two years and then get married  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Ruby grew up in Avonlea as a schoolmate of Anne Shirley, Diana Barry, and Jane Andrews. After studying for the Entrance examinations, she attended Queen's Academy alongside her friends to train as a teacher. Upon graduating, she took up teaching positions, including a stint at the Carmody school. Later, she contracted galloping consumption following an attack of congestion during the winter, forcing her to stop teaching. She spent her final summer at home, coming to terms with her terminal illness, before dying peacefully in her sleep.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P13](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0013), [v1 c23 P5](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0005), [v1 c24 P14](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0014), [v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v1 c37 P34](../source/v01-c37.md#nw-v01-c37-p0034), [v2 c19 P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060), [v3 c11 P4](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0004), [v3 c11 P6](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0006), [v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011), [v3 c14 P30](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0030)_

## Background by volume

- Grew up in a family with many older sisters  <sub>[v1 c18 P15](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0015)</sub>
- Charmed her warts away with a pebble given by Mary Joe  <sub>[v1 c16 P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018)</sub>
- Attended Avonlea School and Queen's Academy with Anne Shirley  <sub>[v1 c32 P42](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0042), [v2 c26 P58](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0058)</sub>

## Quotes

> I’ve a blue silk to make up yet, but it’s a little heavy for summer wear. I think I’ll leave it until the fall. I’m going to teach in White Sands, you know. How do you like my hat? That one you had on in church yesterday was real dinky. But I like something brighter for myself. Did you notice those two ridiculous boys downstairs? They’ve both come determined to sit each other out. I don’t care a single bit about either of them, you know. Herb Spencer is the one I like. Sometimes I really do think he’s Mr. Right. At Christmas I thought the Spencervale schoolmaster was that. But I found out something about him that turned me against him. He nearly went insane when I turned him down. I wish those two boys hadn’t come tonight. I wanted to have a nice good talk with you, Anne, and tell you such heaps of things. You and I were always good chums, weren’t we?  <sub>[v3 c11 P53](../source/v03-c11.md#nw-v03-c11-p0053)</sub>

> Everybody knows it. I know it—I’ve known it all summer, though I wouldn’t give in. And, oh, Anne—I don’t want to die. I’m afraid to die.  <sub>[v3 c14 P11](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0011)</sub>

> It—it won’t be very long now, Anne. I feel sure of that. And I’d rather have you than any one else. I always liked you best of all the girls I went to school with. You were never jealous, or mean, like some of them were. Poor Em White was up to see me yesterday. You remember Em and I were such chums for three years when we went to school? And then we quarrelled the time of the school concert. We’ve never spoken to each other since. Wasn’t it silly? Anything like that seems silly now. But Em and I made up the old quarrel yesterday. She said she’d have spoken years ago, only she thought I wouldn’t. And I never spoke to her because I was sure she wouldn’t speak to me. Isn’t it strange how people misunderstand each other, Anne?  <sub>[v3 c14 P23](../source/v03-c14.md#nw-v03-c14-p0023)</sub>
